definitions.first_half_pick: Pick number in the first half of that season's draft.
definitions.repeat_player: Same ESPN player_id drafted by the same canonical person in multiple seasons.
definitions.player_value_not_included: No player-season fantasy production is present in the normalized draft data, so this engine does not assign draft-hit/value scores.
definitions.draft_slot_note: Because this is a snake draft, total draft capital is not treated as a skill metric; each owner receives essentially the same aggregate pick distribution.
